name: Immigrate to Goiás
description: Goiás is a Brazilian state in the Central-West region, with capital Goiânia, known for its plateaus, national parks like Chapada dos Veadeiros and Emas, hot springs in Caldas Novas, colonial architecture in Goiás Velho, and economy based on agriculture (soy, sugarcane, tomatoes) and mining (nickel, gold).
keywords: Goiás, Goiânia, Chapada dos Veadeiros, Caldas Novas, agriculture, national parks, Sertanejo music
